rationale: Manjot brings 15+ years of mobile and full-stack development expertise (iOS, Android, React Native, Java) and is actively hiring for Android and iOS developers, while John leads engineering operations at Cloudfitters with deep cloud infrastructure (AWS, GCP, Azure) and systems-level programming skills. intro_message: Manjot Singh, meet John Komarnicki — you're both driving technical execution in different layers of the modern stack (mobile & full-stack vs. cloud ops & AI infrastructure), and could compare notes on what's working for enterprise adoption and team-building in your respective domains.
